主要内容: This article provides an overview of 21st Century Fox’s fiscal 2015 earnings, highlighting key financial results and business segments. The company reported revenues of ~$29 billion, a 9% decrease from fiscal 2014, with an adjusted OIBDA of ~$6.5 billion, a 3% increase over the previous year. The Cable Network Programming segment was the largest revenue contributor, accounting for 48% of total revenue with ~$13.8 billion in fiscal 2015. The company also sold its stake in Sky Italia and Sky Deutschland, generating $7.3 billion in net proceeds, and acquired a 21% stake in Sky's National Geographic Channel for $650 million. The article notes that the strong US dollar has negatively impacted earnings for media companies, including The Walt Disney Company (DIS). Investors can gain exposure to 21st Century Fox through the Consumer Discretionary SPDR ETF (XLY), which holds 2.23% of the company’s stock. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include 21st Century Fox (FOXA), Sky (SKYAY).
